title.en: Find labelled packets in the capture

why.en: MPLS sits between Ethernet and IP, so Wireshark has a filter for the label stack itself.
why.hinglish: MPLS Ethernet aur IP ke beech baithta hai, isliye Wireshark mein label stack ke liye alag filter hai.

expect.en: Packets show an MPLS layer with Label, TC, S and TTL fields before the IP header. Values differ in your copy.
expect.hinglish: Packets mein IP header se pehle MPLS layer dikhti hai jisme Label, TC, S aur TTL fields hain. Tumhari copy mein values alag ho sakti hain.

why.en: In the VPN scenario the stack has a transport label and a VPN label; the bottom one has S = 1.
why.hinglish: VPN scenario mein stack mein transport label aur VPN label hote hain; neeche wale par S = 1 hota hai.

expect.en: Only packets whose bottom label is 18 (the SHOP-A VPN label) remain.
expect.hinglish: Sirf woh packets bachte hain jinka bottom label 18 (SHOP-A ka VPN label) hai.

why.en: Many ISPs show MPLS hops in traceroute; some routers even reveal the label in ICMP extensions.
why.hinglish: Bahut se ISPs traceroute mein MPLS hops dikhate hain; kuch routers ICMP extensions mein label bhi bata dete hain.

expect.en: A list of hops with times. It varies by network; hops inside an ISP core may be slow to respond or hidden.
expect.hinglish: Times ke saath hops ki list. Yeh network ke hisaab se alag hoti hai; ISP core ke andar ke hops der se reply de sakte hain ya chhupe ho sakte hain.
